resources.string: Save your settings to a file, or restore them from one, for example when you move to a new phone. The file has no locations, no passwords and nothing from your searches. It stays where you save it.
\"Everything\" also includes your saved places, lists and tracks, in one ZIP file.
Settings saved to the file you chose.
Places and settings saved to the file you chose.
That did not work. Nothing was changed.
This is not a settings file from this app. Nothing was changed.
The file is damaged and cannot be read. Nothing was changed.
The file is too large to be a settings file. Nothing was changed.
This file was made by a newer version of the app (file format %1$d). Update the app to restore it. Nothing was changed.
Switches that stay off until you accept them again: %1$d.
Installed maps listed in the file: %1$d. The Maps screen offers to download them.
Places added: %1$d, already present: %2$d, tracks added: %3$d.
Settings that will be replaced with the values in the file: %1$d.
The file matches your current settings. Nothing will change.
These were on in the file. They are NOT turned on: you will have to accept their notice again.
Installed maps listed in the file: %1$d. Nothing is downloaded now; the Maps screen will offer it.
Entries in the file that cannot be used and will be skipped: %1$d.
The file also has places, lists and tracks. They are added to yours; nothing is deleted.
These were on on your old phone. For your privacy they stay off until you turn them on and accept their notice here.
Maps from your backup that are not installed on this phone: %1$d. Nothing is downloaded until you ask.
Offline mode is on: turn it off to download them.
